subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word to fill in the blank.**

He has a __melancholic__ temperament; he is often ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (4) i.e. "gloomy".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Melancholic: (उदासीन)** - Characterized by or causing or expressing sadness.

 
 
• **Example**: He always had a melancholic look on his face.
 
 
 
• **Gloomy: (उदास) **- Dark or poorly lit, especially so as to appear depressing or frightening.
 
 
• **Example**: The weather today is quite gloomy.
 
 
 
• **"Gloomy" **matches **"melancholic"** because both imply sadness, making it the correct synonym in context.

**Therefore, the correct answer is "*He has a melancholic__ temperament; he is often __gloomy__"******.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Curious**: (जिज्ञासु) - Eager to know or learn something.

 
 
• **Example**: She was curious about the history of the castle.
 
 
 
• **Glad**: (प्रसन्न) - Feeling pleasure or happiness.
 
 
• **Example**: She was glad to hear the good news.
 
 
 
• **Enthusiastic**: (उत्साही) - Having or showing intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval.
 
 
• Example: The children were enthusiastic about the school trip.
